requirements.requirement: A host-managed, recoverable WordPress Multisite database backup exists immediately before the mutation window.
requirements.reason: Options, Reading Settings, menu-location assignments, taxonomy terms, ACF option values, and attachment metadata are not fully recoverable from a WXR content export.
requirements.evidenceRequired: backup identifier, creation timestamp, retention window, responsible administrator, and restore eligibility without persisting a private storage path

requirements.requirement: Each affected tenant has a supplemental tenant-level WordPress content export when records, terms, menus, or relationships are in scope.
requirements.reason: Provides portable record evidence but does not replace the network database backup.
requirements.evidenceRequired: tenant SiteKey, export timestamp, exported object families, export identifier, and checksum

requirements.requirement: Per-record before-state evidence is captured for every Page, editorial record, Project, Company, Service, Investment, Testimonial, Partner, Document, announcement, and media attachment that would be changed.
requirements.evidenceRequired: tenant, databaseId, typename/post type, status, modified timestamp where available, affected field values, relationship IDs, and content-authority decision reference

requirements.requirement: Option/settings before-state evidence is captured before brand, Reading Settings, or ACF option mutation.
requirements.evidenceRequired: tenant, option/field-group coordinate, current sanitized value, target value, and reversible mutation record

requirements.requirement: Menu before-state evidence records every existing menu, item hierarchy, item databaseId, safe destination summary, and PRIMARY/FOOTER/LEGAL assignment.
requirements.evidenceRequired: tenant, menu databaseIds, item databaseIds, hierarchy, locations, and zero-truncation read-only query evidence

requirements.requirement: Taxonomy before-state evidence records exact term slugs, databaseIds, counts, and reviewed record assignments.
requirements.evidenceRequired: tenant, term databaseId, name, exact slug, assigned record databaseIds, and absence/duplication check

requirements.requirement: Media before-state evidence records attachment databaseId, alt text, dimensions, restriction state, and sanitized source-safety result before metadata changes.
requirements.evidenceRequired: tenant, attachment databaseId, alt text before/after, dimensions, and accessibility approval reference

requirements.requirement: Every created object databaseId and every changed relationship ID is captured during the future execution window.
requirements.evidenceRequired: batch ID, action ID, tenant, object type, before databaseId or CREATED marker, resulting databaseId, and validation outcome

requirements.requirement: Restore capability is validated before production cutover through a documented restore check or approved rehearsal appropriate to the host platform.
requirements.evidenceRequired: responsible administrator, validation timestamp, recovery point objective confirmation, and outcome

storageOwnership.requirement: Use an approved access-controlled and encrypted backup store with documented retention.

restoreRules: Never run a restore during Step 2C.5A.
Prefer action-level reversal from captured before-state when safe; use full restore only under a separately authorized incident decision.
Stop the mutation window if the backup cannot be identified, validated, or retained for the approved rollback period.
No record deletion is permitted by the accepted manifest.
